verdict.rationale: Hatchet's docs include first-party cookbooks for the Claude Agent SDK and OpenAI Agents SDK, and show how to expose Hatchet workflows and tasks as tools those frameworks can call. That gives agent steps Hatchet's durability, but through documented recipes rather than packaged wrappers. The cookbooks also run in the opposite direction, putting Hatchet behind tools rather than wrapping the agent stack itself. Missing for 10: packaged first-party integration libraries that wrap AI SDKs or agent frameworks, any model-provider integrations, broader framework coverage beyond two cookbooks, evidence that glue code is eliminated, and independent corroboration.
